title: Board
description: The prudential position the board is accountable for: capital, liquidity, asset quality and the shape of the balance sheet, with what is still outstanding named rather than left blank.

widgets.title: Capital adequacy
widgets.caption: Filed capital ratios at the reporting date, against the prior quarter.

widgets.title: Liquidity and stable funding
widgets.caption: Filed liquidity and stable-funding ratios, against the prior quarter.

widgets.title: Asset quality
widgets.caption: The non-performing share of classified exposure, and the provisions held against it.

widgets.title: Net interest margin
widgets.caption: An analytical figure from the funds transfer pricing module. It is not part of a filed return.

widgets.title: Balance sheet
widgets.caption: Month-end balances by position type over the past year.

widgets.title: Return on assets, return on equity and cost to income
widgets.caption: Earnings ratios are read from the general ledger. They need the bank's account mapping, and the ledger figures are not yet published as measures.

widgets.title: Open limit breaches
widgets.caption: How many limits are currently breached. A count across limits is not yet published as a measure.

widgets.title: Filing calendar
widgets.caption: Upcoming and overdue returns, from the filing workspace.

widgets.title: Performance against budget
widgets.caption: Performance against the bank's own budget. Supply the performance targets dataset to turn it on.
